title: Localized relation membership and Jacobian left inverse from a conormal basis
statement: Let $R,A$ be commutative rings and let $P:R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow A$ be a finite $R$-algebra presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra, def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] with relations $f_0,\ldots,f_{m-1}$ and kernel $I=(f_j)$. Let $a\in A$, let $h=P.\sigma(a)$ be the chosen polynomial lift of $a$, and put $B=A_a$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Assume $B$ smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], $c\leq\min(n,m)$, and a $B$-basis $b_0,\ldots,b_{c-1}$ of $B\otimes_A I/I^2$ with $b_j=1\otimes(f_j\bmod I^2)$. Put $K=(f_0,\ldots,f_{c-1})+I^2$ in the polynomial ring and $D_{ij}=\overline{\partial f_j/\partial x_i}$ in $A$ [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative]. Then every $f_j$ for $j\geq c$ maps into the extension of $K$ in $R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]_h$, and there is a $c\times n$ matrix $L$ over $B$ with $L D_B=1_c$, where $D_B$ is the image of $D$ under $A\to B$.

proof.text: Let N be the A-submodule of the conormal module spanned by the initial c relation classes, and K the polynomial ideal generated by these relations. Submodule.span_induction shows that each element of N is the class of an element of K in the presentation kernel: for scalar multiplication lift the scalar r to the chosen polynomial section sigma(r), and use Cotangent.val_smul to identify the two actions.

The tensor map F: I/I^2 -> A_a tensor_A I/I^2 is a module localization by IsLocalization.tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule. The localized submodule N contains every prescribed basis vector, so it is top by Basis.span_eq. For a relation class, Submodule.mem_localized' gives a denominator s and a numerator z in N. Cancel s and use IsLocalizedModule.eq_iff_exists to clear a second denominator s'. Both are powers of a. Lift z after multiplying by s' using the preceding step. Cotangent.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem gives h^(k+k') f_j minus this lift in I^2, hence the product belongs to K+I^2. Map it to the polynomial localization and cancel the unit image of h^(k+k') by Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem. This proves membership for every relation, including those with index at least c.

Let G be the generators of the presentation and Q the polynomial presentation of A_a obtained by adding the inverse of a. Apply G.principal_localization_naive_cotangent with lift G.sigma(a) to obtain the injectivity equivalence and the equivalence of conormal cokernels. The ring of Q is polynomial, hence formally smooth. Mathlib Extension.cotangentComplex_injective_iff and smoothness of A_a give injectivity of the localized original differential d. Identify its cokernel with the Kahler differentials of A_a using exact_cotangentComplex_toKaehler and the principal-localization cokernel equivalence. These differentials are projective by formal smoothness. Split the quotient map with LinearMap.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective, then apply Function.Exact.split_tfae to obtain l with l.comp d=id.

Let w be the base change of G.cotangentSpaceBasis. Mathlib LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Basis.baseChange_repr_tmul, Extension.cotangentComplex_mk and Generators.cotangentSpaceBasis_repr_tmul show that toMatrix b w d is the displayed matrix D. Set L=toMatrix w b l. LinearMap.toMatrix_comp and toMatrix_id turn l.comp d=id into L*D=1. No nonzero-ring or nonempty-index assumption is used, so empty bases and zero localizations are included.

theorem localized_conormal_basis_jacobian
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    {n m c : ℕ} (P : Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m))
    (hc : c ≤ min n m) (a : A) [Smooth R (Localization.Away a)]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin c) (Localization.Away a)
      (Localization.Away a ⊗[A] P.toExtension.Cotangent))
    (hb : ∀ j : Fin c, b j = 1 ⊗ₜ[A]
      (Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := P.toExtension)
        ⟨P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j),
          P.relation_mem_ker _⟩)) :
    (∀ j : Fin m, c ≤ j.val →
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away (P.σ a)) (P.relation j) ∈
        Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (Localization.Away (P.σ a)))
          (Ideal.span {f | ∃ k : Fin m, k.val < c ∧ f = P.relation k} +
            (Ideal.span (Set.range P.relation)) ^ 2)) ∧
    let D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin c) (Localization.Away a) :=
      fun i j ↦ algebraMap A (Localization.Away a)
        (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val (MvPolynomial.pderiv i
          (P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j))))
    ∃ L : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin n) (Localization.Away a), L * D = 1
